links.outcome: Faithfulness of answers to source text with versus without retrieval-augmented grounding in NICE guidelines
links.effect: RAG raised faithfulness by 64.7 percentage points to 99.5% for O4-Mini; Meditron3-8B without RAG scored 43%.
links.quote: Faithfulness, the measure of whether an answer is supported by the source text, was increased by 64.7 percentage points to 99.5% for the RAG-enhanced O4-Mini model and significantly outperformed the medical-focused Meditron3-8B LLM, which scored 43%.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid embedding retrieval architecture for guideline chunk retrieval evaluated with MRR and recall

screen.practice: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to existing LLMs
screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to LLMs to ground responses in UK NICE clinical guidelines, testing its impact on faithfulness and unsafe responses evaluated by clinical experts.
